en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3790 - Al-Qasim bin Muhammad narrated from Ali bin Abi Hamzah, who said:

I asked Abu Abdillah (as) about a man who bought an orchard that contained palm trees and other trees, some of which had already borne fruit and others had not yet borne fruit.
Imam (as) said: "There is no harm in it if there are trees that have already borne fruit."
